annotations.title: Act on a scene on air

description: Acts on the scene on air, as its operator would; viewers see it at once. goFrame takes a frame to air, next cues one, setControl sets a control, setData replaces a table's rows, skip moves a playlist source to its next item. Changes what is on air, never the draft. Refused with SCENE_OFFLINE while no stream plays the scene.

actionId.description: A new uuid per action. After SCENE_TIMEOUT retry with the same actionId and arguments: it is applied at most once.

controlId.description: setControl: the id in its path control/<id>.

rows.description: setData: the new rows, each an object of column to value. They replace every row.

sourceId.description: setData: the table's id, as in source/data/<id>. skip: the playlist source's id; omitted: the scene's first.

streamId.description: Only when more than one stream plays the scene; from scene_get_live_state.

target.description: goFrame, next: the frame, by the id in its path frame/<id>. next with no target clears the cue.

transition.description: goFrame: how it cuts. Omitted: the frame's own.

value.description: setControl: a toggle true or false, a text a string, a number a number, a select one of its options; none for a button.

name: scene_control_live
